en: Colorized panoramic view over a river valley town surrounded by low mountains and green fields. The river runs through the center with embankments and bridges, and clusters of early 20th‑century buildings with red roofs line both sides. A patch of the image near the foreground is damaged or missing. At the top center, printed text in German reads "Graz gegen Norden." The overall style resembles an old picture postcard.
